title: 법과 규칙: 권리, 의무, 그리고 절차
objective: By the end, you can use ten words about rights, duties, rules, and procedures, such as 권리, 의무, 위반하다, and 신고하다, in short sentences about daily life in Korea.
summary: Ten intermediate words for rights, duties, rules, and official procedures in everyday life in Korea.

task.title: Use the law words
task.line: Read each sentence, decide which word from the list fits the situation, and write it in the correct form.

words.meaning: a right (something the law lets you have or do)
words.exampleMeaning: Workers have the right to rest.

words.meaning: a duty (something you must do by law or rule)
words.example: 부모는 아이를 학교에 보낼 의무가 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Parents have a duty to send their children to school.

words.meaning: procedure; the official steps for doing something
words.exampleMeaning: The visa extension procedure was more complicated than I expected.

words.meaning: a rule or regulation of a company or organization
words.example: 회사 규정에 따라 휴가는 미리 신청해야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: Under company rules, you have to request time off in advance.

words.example: 이 건물 안에서 촬영하려면 허가를 받아야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: You need permission to film inside this building.

words.meaning: to report something to the police or an office
words.exampleMeaning: I lost my wallet, so I reported it to the police station.

words.meaning: to break or violate a rule, law, or contract
words.example: 계약 내용을 위반하면 문제가 생길 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you break the terms of the contract, you can get into trouble.

words.meaning: to be prohibited or not allowed
words.exampleMeaning: Smoking is not allowed in this park.

words.meaning: a fine (money you pay as a penalty)
words.example: 쓰레기를 아무 데나 버리면 벌금을 내야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you throw trash just anywhere, you have to pay a fine.

words.meaning: responsibility; being the one who must answer for something
words.example: 사고가 나면 누구에게 책임이 있는지 확인해야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: If there is an accident, you need to find out who is responsible.

exercises: Choose 권리 or 의무 for each blank: ① 세금을 내는 것은 국민의 ____예요. ② 누구나 자기 생각을 자유롭게 말할 ____가 있어요.
Fill in the blank with 금지되다 in the same form as the word list (-어 있어요): 도서관 안에서는 음식을 먹는 것이 ____ 있어요.
Fill in the blank with 신고하다 in the past tense: 길에서 교통사고를 봐서 바로 112에 ____.
Which word means 'the set of official steps you follow to get something done'? Choose one: 규정 / 절차 / 허가
Choose 허가, 책임, or 규정 for each blank: ① 학교 ____에 따라 시험 중에는 휴대폰을 꺼야 해요. ② 가게 앞에 테이블을 놓으려면 구청의 ____가 필요해요. ③ 개가 사람을 물면 개 주인에게 ____이 있어요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 냈어요 / 주차 규칙을 / 벌금을 / 위반해서
answers: ① 규정 ② 허가 ③ 책임
